about: Short club-spirit phrases for big-text slides.
items: Win together. Lose together. Always together.
Leave the shirt in a better place than you found it.
Train hard, play fair, have fun.
Every club runs on volunteers — thank you.
Hard work beats talent when talent doesn't work hard.
The badge on the front matters more than the name on the back.
Turn up. Join in. Give your best.
Respect the referee — no ref, no game.
Good teams win games. Great teams build each other up.
Practice doesn't make perfect. Perfect practice makes perfect.
Small steps every session add up to big wins.
Be the teammate you'd want to have.
Mistakes mean you're trying. Keep trying.
Shake hands, whatever the score.
Tonight's hero is whoever helped stack the chairs.
Fitness is earned, not given.
Talk on the pitch, laugh in the bar.
Champions keep playing until they get it right.
Your effort is the one thing you always control.
Football, friends and a cup of tea — the perfect Saturday.
Support local sport — it supports all of us.
Discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now.
The best view in sport is from the touchline at your own club.
Encourage the kids — they're the club's future.
One club. One community.
